annotations.title: Analyze Token Market Alpha & Honeypot Risk

description: Aggregate live DexScreener market metrics (USD price, liquidity, FDV, 24h volume, 24h buy/sell order-flow ratio) with GoPlus ERC-20 honeypot/tax checks (for EVM `0x...` tokens) or Token-2022/RugCheck checks (for Solana base58 mints). Read-only composite market + security lookup (5 free calls/hour per IP or unlimited with X-API-Key). Returns JSON with `chain`, `market` (`price_usd`, `liquidity_usd`, `fdv_usd`, `volume_24h_usd`, `buy_pressure_pct`), `security`, `combined_risk_score` (0-100), and `verdict` (`PASS`, `WARN`, `BLOCK`). Use this tool for pre-trade market + security evaluation; use `check_solana_token2022` when you only need raw Solana mint authority inspection without market data.

network.description: Optional chain hint (`base`, `arbitrum`, `ethereum`, `polygon`, `bsc`, `solana`). Leave empty to auto-detect from address format and DexScreener top pair.

token.description: 42-character EVM ERC-20 contract address (`0x...`) or 32-44 character base58 Solana mint address to analyze.

name: analyze_token_alpha
